page_title: CHE 2-1 WHU | Chelsea v West Ham 03/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Filip Jorgensen easily deals with the threat.
90+5' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90+3' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Enzo Maresca has decided to substitute Cole Palmer and he is replaced by Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea).

88' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stuart Attwell no option but to blow his whistle. Chelsea win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
87' Aaron Cresswell goes off the pitch and Luis Guilherme (West Ham) comes on.
86' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
86' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
85' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Chelsea have a corner.

84' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) was too forceful with his tackle and Stuart Attwell interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Chelsea, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
81' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Oliver Scarles (West Ham) heads on.

80' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

78' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
77' Lewis Orford comes onto the pitch because Andrew Irving (West Ham) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
77' Carlos Soler comes off the pitch to be replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
76' Stuart Attwell shows the yellow card to Andrew Irving (West Ham) for a heavy challenge.
74' 2 - 1 Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
73' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
72' Graham Potter prepares a substitution. Vladimir Coufal is replaced by Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham).
71' Substitution. Emerson will be replaced by Oliver Scarles (West Ham).

70' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
70' The corner kick from Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

69' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Corner kick. West Ham will have an opportunity.
68' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
68' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Chelsea players have a reason to celebrate!
67' A yellow card for a tackle by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea). Stuart Attwell doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
66' The Chelsea players halt their celebrations as referee Stuart Attwell makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
64' 1 - 1 Goal! Pedro Neto (Chelsea) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:1.
64' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.

63' A cross by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
61' The substitution has been made. Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) has replaced Noni Madueke.
61' Enzo Maresca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Malo Gusto (Chelsea) replacing Reece James.
59' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
59' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
59' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
57' Today's referee Stuart Attwell rightly decides to book Reece James (Chelsea) for his harsh tackle.
57' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. It's a free kick to West Ham in a dangerous position.

55' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. That's a free kick to West Ham.
54' Andrew Irving (West Ham) commits a rough foul. Stuart Attwell stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to Chelsea.
54' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
52' Here is a change. Jadon Sancho is going off and Enzo Maresca gives the last tactical orders to Pedro Neto (Chelsea).
52' The referee signals a substitution. Marc Guiu (Chelsea) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas Jackson.

52' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
52' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
51' Dangerous play by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea). Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. West Ham get a free kick.
51' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
50' Stuart Attwell couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) and blew his whistle. West Ham earn a free kick.
50' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Moises Caicedo (Chelsea).
48' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
46' Emerson (West Ham) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
46' The whistle blows and Stuart Attwell starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Great touch by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
45+2' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+1' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) was close to scoring from the resulting free kick. He unleashed a decent strike from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but the goalkeeper made a great save to keep him out. The referee points to the corner flag and Chelsea will take a corner.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Max Kilman (West Ham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. Chelsea are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
42' 0 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:1.
41' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
40' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

38' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Filip Jorgensen, who makes a glorious save!
38' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to West Ham.
37' Carlos Soler (West Ham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Chelsea will take a free kick.
36' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. West Ham win a free kick.
33' Reece James (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
33' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
33' A lofted cross from Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
31' Chance! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
30' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
26' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

25' What a chance that is! Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
24' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
24' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

23' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
22' Stuart Attwell blows for a foul after Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
19' Andrew Irving (West Ham) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
19' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
19' The corner from Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) is cleared away by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to West Ham.

18' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman makes the right call and West Ham will have a corner.
15' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
11' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. West Ham are awarded the free kick.
10' Reece James (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
10' A pass from Andrew Irving (West Ham) is intercepted by Filip Jorgensen and the move breaks down.
8' The foul by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) was seen by Stuart Attwell who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. West Ham will take a free kick near the side line.
8' Reece James (Chelsea) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

7' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
6' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
5' Andrew Irving (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Chelsea, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
2' A pass into the penalty area from Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is intercepted by the defence.
1' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game. One of the players from Chelsea won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. West Ham have a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Stuart Attwell.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
